Definition
[scalar curvature]

↗ def:dc-ch4-4-ricci-form

1. ch4:4The (unnormalized) scalar curvature at $p$ is the trace of the Ricci form $Q$, \[ \mathrm{trace}(Q)=\sum _j Q(e_j,e_j)=\sum _{ij}\langle R(e_i,e_j)e_i,e_j\rangle =\sum _{ij}B(e_i,e_j,e_i,e_j), \] again independent of the orthonormal basis $\{ e_i\} $ (a trace of a trace). do Carmo's normalized scalar curvature is $K(p)=\frac{1}{n(n-1)}\mathrm{trace}(Q)$.
